_comment: Source of truth for WagerProof Meta ads. SAFETY: the client ONLY operates on adAccountId below — the signed-in Meta user also has access to Honeydew, Orbital Focus + other accounts; never repoint it. Run `node client/meta.mjs check` before shipping.

app._webComment: Web conversion funnel, NOT app promotion. This is the only place SUBSCRIBE actually exists: the pixel logs Subscribe/InitiateCheckout/ViewContent/CompleteRegistration, while the mobile app has never logged a SUBSCRIBE app event. Conversions here bill through RevenueCat Web billing, not Apple. Targets iOS users because that is the audience the app creative was built for.

defaults.message: Stop guessing. WagerProof's AI breaks down every game — win probabilities, live money flow, and the highest-value plays across the NFL, NBA, and college. Every pick tracked publicly, no cherry-picking. Bet smarter.
defaults.headline: Your AI sports betting edge.

_optimizationComment: What Meta optimizes delivery toward. PURCHASE is the money event: RevenueCat's Facebook integration sends subscriptions as fb_mobile_purchase, so `purchase` is what actually has signal. `subscribe` is kept only to document that it was tested and failed — the SUBSCRIBE event is never sent, so Meta optimizes against nothing ($9.5k spend -> 5 purchases, 0.02 ROAS, vs 1.09 on the same creative under PURCHASE). Do not use it.

subscribe.label: Subscribe
subscribe.disabledForApps: No SUBSCRIBE event is ever sent to Meta — RevenueCat reports subscriptions as PURCHASE. Burned $9,534 for $153 revenue. Use --optimize purchase.
